note: Synthetic compositions annotated before the first live call. Roles and directed endpoints only; intended geometry and artwork need separate inspection. Expectations are not included in model prompts.

cases.text: A butterfly hovers above a flower while a bee rests beside the flower.
A key lies below a book, and the book lies below a cloud.
A student holds a key while a bird stands beside the student.
A red cup stands beside a blue book, with a flower above the cup.
A green umbrella rests next to a yellow ladder, with a cloud above the ladder.
